unsupported.question: I took three months off in the middle. Does my experience have to be continuous?
unsupported.claim: Federal Skilled Worker requires 1 year of continuous work.
unsupported.note: Source 1 states meeting either 1 year continuous or 1,560 total hours satisfies requirements.

unsupported.question: Can I average my four test scores together?
unsupported.claim: Disability is the only exception to the rule against averaging language scores.
unsupported.note: Sources mention disability averaging but do not state it is the only exception.

unsupported.question: I'm a welder with no degree. Can I still immigrate federally?
unsupported.claim: Having welder experience automatically makes a candidate eligible for category-based selection rounds in the trade category.
unsupported.note: Source [2] requires 12 months of full-time experience in the past 3 years.

unsupported.question: My twelve months in that occupation weren't back to back. Is that a problem?
unsupported.claim: Non-continuous work can add up to qualify under general Express Entry requirements.
unsupported.note: Sources do not state that general non-continuous work qualifies for Express Entry.

unsupported.question: I'm an early childhood educator. Is there a category for me?
unsupported.claim: Eligibility requires at least 12 months of full-time experience (or equivalent), not necessarily continuous, in the past 3 years in a single listed occupation, in Canada or abroad.
unsupported.note: Source [1] mentions 12 months of full-time experience but not '(or equivalent)'.
